analytic_results_obtained_before_computa: Normalized cross energy rho_S = E_Beta(q,q)[det(M) det(t M^-1 + (1-t) S M^-1 S)]^-1/2.
Pair q-power bound factor 1-(1-2^(1-q))(1-rho_S); proof by log-concavity of sinh(qt).
Full finite-group Holder bound: integral(P_Gamma H)^q <= A*(average_S rho_S)^(q-1), A=area(S4)*det(M)^(-1/8).
For one coordinate flip, kappa=(M^-1)_ii-1, s=kappa/(1+kappa), rho=sqrt(1-s) sum_n (1/2)_n^2/((7/4)_n*n!)*s^n; 1-rho >= 5s/14.
General sign bipartition determinant ratio is a product of 1+4t(1-t)*kappa_j; rank-dependent principal-minor bound must use C_rank, with C_2=3.
A purely analytic coarse R moment closure follows from E_R sum_{i<j}M_ij^2=10/3. This numerical batch does not evaluate the resulting global I or C5 expression.
